warnings: narrow: gate_width_m 1.5 != 4.0. runtime.detection_geometry converts apparent size at the nominal gates.GATE_WIDTH_M = 4.0, so a raw sighting reads 2.67x its true range until the pilot has triangulated the width for itself (SightParams.width_est); the first arch is flown before there is parallax to do that with. The 11 px detector floor also cuts sight off at 14 m instead of 36 m, which is a real property of the course. flightlog.gate_crossings still scores with a 2.0 m half width, so read through_w (at 0.75 m) on this course, not through.

wide: gate_width_m 8.0 != 4.0. runtime.detection_geometry converts apparent size at the nominal gates.GATE_WIDTH_M = 4.0, so a raw sighting reads 0.50x its true range until the pilot has triangulated the width for itself (SightParams.width_est); the first arch is flown before there is parallax to do that with. The 11 px detector floor also cuts sight off at 73 m instead of 36 m, which is a real property of the course. flightlog.gate_crossings still scores with a 2.0 m half width, so read through_w (at 4.00 m) on this course, not through.

narrow.breaks: gate width 1.5 m (Straw Bale is 4 m)

wide.breaks: gate width 8 m (Straw Bale is 4 m)

descending.breaks: passage height falls 9.0 -> 1.2 m (Straw Bale only ever climbs)

gate_pair.breaks: two gates 6 m apart on one line, twice

hairpin.breaks: a >150 deg direction reversal between two legs

long_legs.breaks: gates 85-95 m apart (Straw Bale is 15-40 m)

offaxis_start.breaks: the first gate is 90 deg to the side of the spawn heading
